reviews.text:
Booth Company Real Estate was phenomenal, we were in a time crunch to get the house on the market to pay for  an assisted living facility for my grandmother. In the middle of the process my grandmother passed away. Adam was patient and understanding the entire time, he even made keeping in touch and signing documents easy while my mother was traveling.

This wasn't our first time selling a house and despite everything else going on it was easily the best experience we have had. Adam, thank you so much for everything.

If you want a smooth home buying or selling process Adam's your guy, our home sold within nine days of being on the market! Adam communicated and gave updates throughout the closing process, and was quick with solutions when a couple closing issues arised.

Adam was truly great to work with. He went above and beyond to help us sell a house and buy a house. People told us we couldn't get a loan. With out Adam we would have gave up. If you need a agent to stand behind you and go above and beyond no better person then Adam Booth. Thank you Adam Booth for being such a great agent and friend
Adam was great to work with, guiding me through the process of getting my house ready to sell. He kept me updated once the house was listed and it sold in two days.
Best realtor around. Made everything less stressful, very knowledgeable and detail-oriented, and got us an amazing deal on our house. I can’t recommend him enough!

Had a great experience working with Adam to buy our home. We had an extensive list of needs for finding the right one and Adam was very helpful, knowledgeable and patient with us. Looking for the best? Looking no further.

Very helpful and reached out to different people to get the info we needed.  The experience was seamless,  and we got into our new home really quick.   We are both really slow (being first time home buyers) so it was nice to have someone explain things multiple times.
Adam really listened to what I needed and help me find the perfect home for my family. Quick, responsive, friendly and honest. 6/5 stars

Adam Booth was the best in saling our house and making it possible to get our new home ...it took 3 weeks from day 1 to day done stayed in touch daily was there day and night for any question  are we were told no from r bank Adam told us we got this I will get you in the house he hook us up with a broker that was as helpful as Adam was and now we r in our new home 2 weeks here and Adam just called tonight to check on us to make sure we were happy and if we need anything he is a phone call away...very impressed with this man ..so for all you needs in buying or saling Adam Booth is your man...
Adam was awesome.  We highly recommend using Booth Company Real Estate
